profile.summary: Panorama Studios International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and distribution of media entertainment and content in India. It offers film production, project development, post production, film distribution, music, talent management, equipment rental, publicity and design, syndication, and line production services. The company was formerly known as Apunka Invest
